How is this different from other signal groups?

The rules are fixed and were tested on broker data since 2019. The ideas we tested and threw away, and the losing year, are on this page too. Every real signal's result, winners and losers alike, is open.

Today's levels worked out from yesterday's high, low and close. R (resistance) is where a rise may stall, S (support) where a fall may stall, and the pivot sits between.

Highs (BSL) and lows (SSL) where many traders' stops collect. A sweep is when the price briefly runs past such a level, takes those stops, and turns back.
A gap left inside three candles after a fast, strong move, where little traded. Price often comes back to fill it, so it is watched as an entry zone.
